content.text: In Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and currency collapse pressure-tested the infrastructure of COREMERCH, a sovereign commerce infrastructure company, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-what-nobody-tells|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-what-actually-how-2|Digital Product]] creators found a solution to the Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad problem: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-5|cloudflare]] Pages and NOWPayments — a combination that gives them a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. With this infrastructure, creators can avoid the platform lock-in, subscription fees, and restrictive payment policies that have long plagued digital commerce, building a store that truly belongs to them.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The combination of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery creates a resilient architecture that can withstand platform restrictions and currency fluctuations. By deploying this infrastructure, creators can break free from the dependence on conventional payment platforms and collect payments directly in their own digital stores using NOWPayments, a fee-free on-ramp to the crypto economy.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying the infrastructure, creators need to have a digital product to sell, a Crypto wallet to receive payments, and a basic understanding of how the infrastructure works. Additionally, they need to sign up for a Cloudflare account, create a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages site, and install the necessary apps and scripts. With these prerequisites in place, creators can start building their digital store and integrating NOWPayments for crypto payment processing.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up the payment and delivery pipeline, creators need to configure NOWPayments as the payment processor, integrate it with their Cloudflare Pages site, and set up the Supabase or Google Sheets database to store orders. They also need to configure the Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket for file delivery and ensure that the SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records are properly set up to prevent email spoofing. With these settings in place, creators can start processing payments and delivering products to their customers.
Creators can deploy the infrastructure in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint for $47.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once the infrastructure is set up, creators can go live and start processing their first transaction. To do this, they need to add products to their store, set up the payment gateway, and configure the delivery pipeline. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), creators can deploy Stack 02 in 48 hours and have a fully operational digital store with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff. By following this guide, creators can go live and start processing their first transaction without any issues.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once the infrastructure is running, creators can start scaling their digital store. To do this, they need to add more products, increase the storage capacity, and improve the delivery pipeline. They can also use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to download the full source code, NOWPayments integration guide, and scaling playbook, and use the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) to deploy the infrastructure in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint.
